instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Community health foundation running maternal and child health programs, vaccination campaigns, and nutrition interventions in underserved urban communities. Team of 60 community health workers and 12 program managers. Evaluating mobile-based patient tracking and automated appointment reminder systems for immunization schedule adherence. We operate across multiple locations and have distinct functional leadership for operations, commercial, finance, and technology. Our annual planning process is well-established but can be rigid — mid-cycle innovation funding requires navigating a formal business case approval chain involving 3-4 stakeholders.
answers.pastInitiatives: We piloted a cloud-based project management tool last year, but adoption was inconsistent across teams and we ultimately reverted to spreadsheets and email for most project tracking. The experience highlighted that tool adoption requires more structured change management than we initially planned for.
answers.strategicGoals: We are heavily dependent on a single product category and a concentrated customer base — our top 3 clients represent 55% of revenue. This concentration risk is unacceptable for our long-term health. We need to identify and develop new revenue streams, possibly including new product lines for different customer segments or entirely new business models that leverage our existing capabilities.
answers.teamSize: We have a dedicated innovation squad of 8 people — 4 engineers, 1 data scientist, 1 UX designer, 1 product manager, and a part-time business analyst. This team operates with its own sprint cadence separate from the core product teams and has an allocated annual innovation budget. They report progress quarterly to the executive committee.

input.changes_since_last: Restructured leadership team. 6 legacy processes automated. Exploring new revenue streams.

opportunities.title: Develop Diverse Revenue Streams via Managed Community Health Services
opportunities.rationale: The current over-dependence (55% of revenue) on the top three clients presents an unacceptable concentration risk. This opportunity requires moving beyond optimizing existing service lines and developing entirely new business models that utilize the core competency (CHWs, local knowledge) for different customer segments or payer sources.

first_actions: Conduct a regulatory feasibility study to certify new revenue streams in non-traditional care settings.
Develop 2-3 pilot service packages targeting secondary/underrepresented client demographics (e.g., occupational health, remote monitoring).
Establish a formalized pricing structure and risk assessment framework for outsourced services.
execution_plan.success_metric: Securing initial paid contracts with at least two non-core client segments by Q3.
milestones: Completion of regulatory gap analysis for new services.
Executive approval for minimum viable product (MVP) testing.

opportunities.title: Implement Standardized, Compliant Digital Patient Tracking Pathways
opportunities.rationale: While mobile tracking was piloted, the process needs formalization to ensure consistent adoption and compliance across multiple locations. Leveraging the dedicated innovation squad can build a robust digital backbone that enhances adherence and provides auditable records.

first_actions: Map the end-to-end patient journey, ensuring every touchpoint has defined data capture and compliance gates (e.g., consent forms).
Integrate localized privacy and security protocols into the chosen cloud platform.
Conduct comprehensive change management training for program managers and CHWs on new digital workflows.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in manual data entry errors by 20% and achieving 90% adoption rate among primary program teams.
milestones: Finalized compliance architecture for the digital tool.
Pilot deployment with one representative, high-volume location.
Full scale rollout plan approved by the executive committee.

next_steps.action: Formalize a cross-functional working group responsible for monitoring and accelerating diversification initiatives (Opp 1), requiring commitment from Finance, Operations, and Commercial Leads.
Conduct a deep-dive root cause analysis on the failure of previous tool adoption to identify critical process gaps in change management methodology.
Schedule a quarterly strategic review focused solely on reviewing client concentration risk metrics and identifying three alternative revenue sources/client types.

key_weaknesses: Extreme dependence on top 3 clients, creating significant single-source revenue risk.
Process rigidity in the annual planning cycle hinders mid-cycle innovation funding and agility.
Inconsistent change management adoption demonstrated by previous technology rollouts (reverting to manual processes).

improvements: Restructuring of leadership provides clearer accountability for complex initiatives.
Automation of 6 legacy operational processes frees up capacity and standardizes core functions.
Dedicated innovation squad structure allows for focused, structured exploration outside of core product cycles.
persistent_gaps: Mitigation strategy for client concentration risk remains underdeveloped.
The relationship between the dedicated 'innovation' budget/squad and the formal operational planning committee needs clearer governance to ensure adoption.
Lack of standardized, scalable change management protocols applied across all tech implementations.
achieved_milestones: Defined cross-functional functional leadership (Operations, Commercial, Tech).
Increased dedicated budget allocation for innovation (18% of over_$50m revenue).

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Significant improvement in organizational structure and resource allocation (dedicated squad/budget). The focus has sharply shifted toward high-risk, high-reward diversification strategies to address extreme revenue concentration risk.
